about_short_description.short_description: IN1 operates as a financial management app.

product.name: IN1 App
product.description: A financial management app that allows users to send, spend, earn money, and manage both fiat and cryptocurrency assets in one platform.

product.name: IN1 Account
product.description: A user account that enables access to IN1 services, including fiat and cryptocurrency transactions, balance management, and payment initiation.

product.name: IN1 Wallet
product.description: A digital wallet integrated with the IN1 Account for storing, managing, and transacting supported cryptocurrencies and digital assets.

product.name: IN1 Card
product.description: A Mastercard® branded debit card linked to the IN1 Account for making purchases and ATM withdrawals using fiat or cryptocurrency balances.

product.name: IN1 Hub
product.description: An internal marketplace within the IN1 platform offering various services and products with cashback offers for users.
